tests.description: Pressing Space makes the player jump off the platform it stands on, and gravity brings it back down at the same place.
tests.name: Jumping with Space
source: // The player must be able to jump off the ground with the Space key
// The player starts in the air: wait for it to land on the ground platform.
harness.assert(landed, 'The player falls and lands on the ground platform.');
// Standing still must not move the player vertically.
'The player stays on the ground while no key is pressed.'
// Jump: hold Space long enough to benefit from the jump sustain time.
harness.assert(leftTheFloor, 'The player leaves the floor when jumping.');
'The player rises well above the ground when jumping (rose by ' +
// ...and gravity brings it back down on the same platform.
harness.assert(landedBack, 'The player falls back onto the floor.');
'The player lands back at the height it jumped from.'
'A jump without a direction key does not move the player horizontally.'

tests.description: The player drops down to the ground and runs over the row of coins: every coin it touches is collected.
tests.name: Collecting the coins by running into them
source: // Coins are picked up by touching them: the player starts on a raised
// platform and has to drop down to the ground to run over the coins there.
harness.assert(landed, 'The player lands on its starting platform.');
harness.assert(coinsBefore > 0, 'There are coins to collect in the level.');
// Standing still collects nothing: this is what makes the checks below a
// test of the player moving into the coins.
'There is a row of coins on the ground below the starting platform (found ' +
// Run right until the platform ends and the player drops down.
harness.assert(fell, 'Running right takes the player off the edge of the platform.');
harness.assert(landedBelow, 'The player lands on the ground below.');
'The player is now down on the ground, next to the coins.'
'Falling down next to the coins does not collect them yet.'
// Run back left, over the row of coins.
'Running over the row of coins collects every one of them (' +
'Only the coins the player ran into were collected.'
// A picture of what the game looks like once this has happened, kept with
await harness.takeScreenshot('the level once every coin has been collected');

tests.description: Clicking 3 times chains Attack1->Attack2->Attack3 then returns to Idle
tests.name: Attack combo chains 1-2-3
source: harness.assert(p.animation === 'Attack2', 'Second click chains to Attack2, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Attack3', 'Third click chains to Attack3, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Idle' || p.animation === 'Run', 'Combo ends back to Idle/Run, got '+p.animation);

tests.description: Combo works standing still; moving or jumping cancels the attack
tests.name: Attack cancel with move or jump
source: harness.assert(p.animation === 'Attack2', 'Second click chains to Attack2, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(stage && stage.value === 0, 'Moving cancels combo (stage 0), got '+(stage && stage.value));
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Run', 'Moving during attack switches to Run, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(stage && stage.value === 0, 'Jump cancels combo (stage 0), got '+(stage && stage.value));
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Jump' || p.animation === 'Fall', 'Jump during attack switches to Jump/Fall, got '+p.animation);
